shared_elements: representation of human eyes and facial features
justification: A is a rounded-topped stele showing a lunette scene of small standing figures beneath a rayed disc above many dense registers of script signs, while B is a single sculpted head in the round with a broad face, incised brows and lidded eyes and no accompanying scene or signs. The only correspondence is the generic presence of human representation; A's relief figures are tiny, profile and schematic within a text-dominated field, whereas B is a large frontal three-dimensional face, so relationships and arrangement have nothing in common.
